examples.text: You may have ~ enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except it's an enchantment in addition to its other types.
You may have ~ enter as a copy of an artifact you control, except it isn't legendary and it has vigilance.
You may have ~ enter as a copy of a creature an opponent controls, except it's 2/2 and it has flying.
